related.description: 🎧 Open source music streaming app! Available for both desktop & mobile!
RiMusic is a multilingual and multiplatform application for streaming music
First of its kind, A simple TUI online music streaming application written in c++ with easy vim motions, now with support for Model Context...
Self-hosted music streaming server 🎶 with RESTful API and Web interface. Think of it as your very own Spotify! ☁️🎧
Streaming music player that finds free music for you
